title: Meet Md Ayan in 40 seconds
subtitle: Recorded, zoomed and narrated by an AI agent

scenes.say: Most portfolios are a list of links. This one is a story, about an overthinker who builds.
Hover over his photo, and he starts thinking out loud.
Jump to the work. Real products, used by real people.
Filter to AI, and the research shows up.
Like MIP. A security layer that cut data theft by a hijacked agent from ninety five percent to about one.
And when you want to talk, it's one click away.
Still overthinking. Still building. Go say hi.
